notes: ResourceCase receives an explicit 20-aa protein and this module RetainedClient, so its HMMER QUERY/default RetainedClient are not used after import.
ScientificProcessLibrary.freeze does not open URLs, retained_source paths or sources named in provenance: it reads index.json, option_sources.json and declared entry detail paths only.
ScientificToolLibrary freezes supplied real catalogs and packaged instructions, then uses only run-local snapshots.
All generated Store/artifact/run files remain under pytest tmp_path in the bounded scratch directory. No native executable is selected.
